name: quotadock
description: Local-first AI quota bridge for iPhone, Apple Watch and widgets

scripts.start: npm run build && node bridge/cli.mjs serve
scripts.demo: npm run build && node bridge/cli.mjs serve --demo
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test bridge/*.test.mjs && playwright test --config web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
